title: Primary Neuronal Culture and Transient Transfection
author: Shun-Cheng Tseng

steps.title: Prepare boric acid buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.24 g boric acid and 1.90 g sodium tetraborate in sterile ddH₂O, adjust pH to 8.5 with 1 M NaOH, bring volume to 400 mL, store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Make poly‑L‑lysine stock and working solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 50 mg poly‑L‑lysine in 50 mL boric‑acid buffer to obtain 1 mg/mL stock; filter through a top‑bottle filter, store at 4 °C. Dilute stock with the same buffer to 100 µg/mL for coating.

steps.title: Prepare calcium‑free HBSS (CMF‑HBSS)
steps.instruction: Mix 5 mL 1 M HEPES (final 10 mM) and 5 mL penicillin‑streptomycin (100 U/mL from 10 000 U/mL stock) with 10× HBSS to a final volume of 500 mL (1×), add sterile ddH₂O to volume, store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare DNase I solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 10 mg DNase I in 1 mL ddH₂O (10 mg/mL), aliquot into 1.5 mL tubes, store at ‑20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare digestion medium
steps.instruction: Combine 1 mL 1 M HEPES (final 10 mM) with 100 mL 0.25 % trypsin‑EDTA, aliquot into 15 mL tubes, store at ‑20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare L‑glutamine solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.46 g L‑glutamine in ddH₂O to 50 mL (200 mM); warm at 37 °C for 30 min, vortex every 5 min, aliquot into 1.5 mL tubes, store at ‑20 °C.

steps.title: Make neuronal plating medium
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL 0.6 % D‑glucose, 750 µL 5 % FBS, and 150 µL 2 mM L‑glutamine solution to MEM, then bring volume to 15 mL with MEM.

steps.title: Make neuronal maintenance medium
steps.instruction: Add 125 µL 0.5 mM L‑glutamine (from 200 mM stock) and 1 mL 1× B27 supplement (50× stock) to neurobasal medium, bring final volume to 50 mL; protect from light and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Coat coverslips or dishes with PLL
steps.instruction: Wash 12 mm coverslips once with acetone and twice with absolute ethanol on a shaker at 90 rpm for 15 min at room temperature; rinse three times with sterile ddH₂O in a laminar flow cabinet; place coverslips in a 24‑well plate (or dishes) and aspirate water; add 200 µL (well) or 7 mL (dish) of 100 µg/mL PLL solution, incubate overnight at room temperature protected from UV; wash twice with ddH₂O and air‑dry; store coated items at 4 °C for up to one week.

steps.title: Dissect embryos and isolate brains
steps.instruction: Euthanize pregnant E17.5 dams with CO₂, spray abdominal fur with 75 % ethanol, cut fur to expose skin and muscle, remove uterus with embryos using Dumont #5 forceps, place embryos in ice‑cold CMF‑HBSS; under a stereomicroscope, cut skin and skull with Dumont #7 forceps, squeeze out brains, transfer brains to a new dish with ice‑cold CMF‑HBSS.

steps.title: Isolate cortex and hippocampus
steps.instruction: Using Dumont #5 forceps, separate cortical hemispheres and remove meninges; dissect hippocampi from both hemispheres, removing fimbriae with Dumont #5 forceps and iridectomy scissors; place hippocampi and cortexes into separate 15 mL tubes containing 5 mL digestion medium.

steps.title: Digest tissue
steps.instruction: Incubate tubes at 37 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Wash out digestion medium
steps.instruction: Replace digestion medium with room‑temperature CMF‑HBSS, let stand 3 min; repeat this wash two more times (total three washes) to diffuse residual enzyme.

steps.title: Add DNase I to tissue suspensions
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL DNase I solution to the hippocampus tube and 200 µL DNase I solution to the cortex tube.

steps.title: Triturate and filter cell suspensions
steps.instruction: For hippocampi: pipette 10 times with a 10 mL serological pipette, then 10 times with the same pipette fitted with a 1 000 µL tip until dissociated. For cortexes: pipette 20 times with a 10 mL pipette, then 20 times with the 1 000 µL tip. Filter each suspension through a 70 µm cell strainer.

steps.title: Centrifuge dissociated neurons
steps.instruction: Spin at 100 × g for 10 min at room temperature, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in plating medium
steps.instruction: Flick the tube bottom a few times and resuspend the cell pellet in pre‑warmed (37 °C) and pre‑equilibrated neuronal plating medium.

steps.title: Count viable cells
steps.instruction: Mix cell suspension with 0.2 % trypan blue, count using a hemocytometer.

steps.title: Seed neurons onto PLL‑coated surfaces
steps.instruction: Plate cells at 2.5 × 10³ cells/cm² for low‑density or 3 × 10⁴ cells/cm² for regular‑density in 500 µL plating medium per well.

steps.title: First medium change (4 h)
steps.instruction: After 4 h, replace plating medium with a 1:1 mixture of freshly made plating medium and conditioned medium (low‑density) or with neuronal maintenance medium (regular‑density). Conditioned medium is prepared by culturing 2.2 × 10⁶ cortical neurons in a PLL‑coated 10 cm dish for 7 days; store at ‑20 °C.

steps.title: Electroporate neurons (optional)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 1 × 10⁶ neurons at 80 × g for 10 min at room temperature, discard supernatant; resuspend pellet in 100 µL room‑temperature mouse neuron nucleofector solution plus 3 µg DNA, transfer to sterile cuvette; electroporate using Nucleofector program O‑005; immediately add 330 µL pre‑warmed RPMI 1640, gently transfer to a 1.5 mL tube, incubate 10 min at 37 °C in a CO₂ incubator; seed into wells at the densities described above; after 4 h replace medium with fresh neuronal maintenance medium; protein expression detectable after ~24 h.

steps.title: Cationic lipid transfection (Lipofectamine 2000)
steps.instruction: At least 48 h after seeding, prepare DNA‑LFA complexes: dilute 1 µg plasmid DNA with 50 µL neurobasal medium, dilute 1 µL Lipofectamine 2000 with 50 µL neurobasal medium; after 5 min, combine the two solutions, flick to mix, incubate 20 min at room temperature; add the mixture to each well; 45 min later replace medium with the same 1:1 mixture of fresh plating medium and conditioned medium (low‑density) or neuronal maintenance medium (regular‑density); protein detectable after ~24 h.
